quote_1: Ran a ⟦T1⟧ on our document-QA agent, keeping the exact same execution model but routing the planning step through a much cheaper backend.
quote_2: ⟦T2⟧ was measured by replacing only the tool-selection module during the same interrupted runs.
justification: Both describe controlled substitution of one agent component while holding other components fixed. ⟦T1⟧ specifically changes the planning backend and evaluates task success, whereas ⟦T2⟧ changes tool selection and measures action use under task conditions.
